style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimalist womens-flat-shoe ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm mist-grey #EDEBE8 panels, charcoal text #2B2B2B, one caramel suede accent #B07B4F, with deep espresso brown #3A2E26 reserved for the outsole macro only; bright soft diffused studio lighting with overhead or front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with boxed charcoal section label bars; consistent thin-line icons with thin-weight numbered badges and thin connector arcs; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; matte white tabletop surfaces with printed lookbook magazines as the only recurring props; stable product scale with full framed compositions, suede nap texture always clearly visible, lugged outsole shown in at least one shot; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: pairs shown either at slight 3/4 or as overhead flat-lays, staggered toes, consistent scale across the set, suede nap texture always clearly visible, lugged outsole shown in at least one shot
